comments.text:
Those houses are so close together that I bet everyone knows what their neighbors are up to
 Anyone from Bungin know what it's like growing up in such a crowded place? 🤩🤩

replies.author: @RemoteEarthJourneys
replies.text: That's exactly what makes Bungin so fascinating. I'd love to hear from someone who grew up there about what daily life with so many close neighbors feels like.

comments.author: @TravelUnknown-1602
comments.text: What stands out to me is how closely everyday life is connected to the sea. Fishing isn't just a tradition here; it's how many families earn a living and put food on the table. I wonder what happens when the catch is good but there aren't enough facilities to store or sell it. How do local families manage?

replies.author: @RemoteEarthJourneys
replies.text: That's a thoughtful question. Access to ice, transport and buyers can make a real difference for fishing families. It would be interesting to hear from Bungin residents about how they handle a particularly good catch.
